AURORAMOD-AURORA_STRIKE.title: Strike
AURORAMOD-AURORA_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were in [gold]Cold[/gold] or [gold]Warm[/gold] before playing this, gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward. If you were in [gold]Overload[/gold], lose 1 [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEFEND.title: Defend
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_WAKE.title: Reactor Wake
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_WAKE.descriptio: If you were in the [gold]Cold[/gold] zone before playing, set [gold]Heat[/gold] to {TargetHeat}. Otherwise, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH.title: System Crash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYSTEM_CRASH.descriptio: Unplayable. While this is in your [gold]hand[/gold], your Attacks deal 25% less damage; multiple copies do not stack, and automatic damage such as [gold]Modules[/gold] is unaffected.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BREACHING_THRUST.title: Breaching Thrust
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SIDESTEP.title: Sidestep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SIDESTEP.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If already [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing, gain {ChainedBlock} [gold]Block[/gold] instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEARING_CUT.title: Searing Cut
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEARING_CUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target intends to attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Then gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BLADE.title: Deploy: Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BLADE.descriptio: [gold]Deploy[/gold] an [gold]Attack Module[/gold] whose end-of-turn damage is {ModuleValue:diff()}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MELTDOWN_SLASH.title: Meltdown Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MELTDOWN_SLASH.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were in [gold]Overload[/gold] before playing, deal it twice, then [gold]Ignite[/gold]: immediately trigger one [gold]Overheat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CROSSFIRE.title: Crossfire
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CROSSFIRE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Trigger all Attack [gold]Modules[/gold] once. Then gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EJECT_CORE.title: Eject Core
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EJECT_CORE.description: [gold]Vent[/gold] all [gold]Heat[/gold]. If you have any [gold]Modules[/gold], enhance the one with the lowest current value by the amount of [gold]Heat[/gold] actually [gold]Vented[/gold], up to 8.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Then trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ATTACK_MODULE_TOKEN.des: At the end of your turn, this [gold]Module[/gold] deals {Value} damage, prioritizing the enemy with the most [gold]Lock[/gold] applied by you; ties or no [gold]Lock[/gold] are random. Choose this card to replace the [gold]Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SHIELD_MODULE_TOKEN.des: At the start of your turn, this [gold]Module[/gold] grants {Value} [gold]Block[/gold]. Choose this card to replace the [gold]Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BULWARK.title: Deploy: Bulwark
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DEPLOY_BULWARK.descript: [gold]Deploy[/gold] a [gold]Shield Module[/gold] whose start-of-turn [gold]Block[/gold] is {ModuleValue}.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Then trigger the new module once.}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TARGET_PAINTER.title: Target Painter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_SHIELD.title: Vent Shield
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold]. For each [gold]Heat[/gold] actually [gold]Vented[/gold], gain {BlockPerHeat} more [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LINKED_DEFENSE.title: Linked Defense
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LINKED_DEFENSE.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Trigger all Shield [gold]Modules[/gold] once. If you were in the [gold]Cold[/gold] zone before playing, trigger them once more.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_AUXILIARY_HARDPOINT.des: This combat, increase your [gold]Module slot[/gold] limit by 1, up to 3. Then choose to deploy an [gold]Attack Module[/gold] or [gold]Shield Module[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATING_SHELL.title: Ablating Shell
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATING_SHELL.descript: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you were in [gold]Cold[/gold] or [gold]Warm[/gold] before playing this, gain {ChargedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] instead, then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROVOCATION.title: Provocation
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROVOCATION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Apply {ProtocolStacks} [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] to the target. For each stack actually added, gain {MomentumPerStack} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FIELD_MAINTENANCE.title: Field Maintenance
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FIELD_MAINTENANCE.descr: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have any [gold]Modules[/gold], give {ModuleEnhancement:diff()} [gold]Enhancement[/gold] to the [gold]Module[/gold] with the fewest [gold]Enhancements[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VALIDATION_LOOP.title: Validation Loop
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHALLENGE_RIPOSTE.title: Challenge Riposte
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHALLENGE_RIPOSTE.descr: Remove all [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] you applied to the target. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerStack:diff()} additional damage for each stack actually removed. Then [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentPerStack} [gold]Heat[/gold] for each stack actually removed.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PARALLEL_PROCESSING.des: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Scan[/gold] {ScanCount}. For each card actually moved, gain {BlockPerMoved:diff()} more [gold]Block[/gold]. If you were already [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this, draw {DrawCount} cards afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_THRUST.title: Reactor Thrust
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_THRUST.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If gaining {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward would make you [gold]Overheat[/gold], first gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_ARC.title: Adaptive Arc
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_ARC.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target intends to attack, apply {WeakPower} [gold]Weak[/gold] afterward. Otherwise, apply {LockStacks} [gold]Lock[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RAPID_COMMAND.title: Rapid Command
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RAPID_COMMAND.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this was the rightmost card in your [gold]hand[/gold] when played, deal {RightDamage:diff()} damage instead, then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_SWEEP.title: Thermal Sweep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_SWEEP.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. [gold]Cold[/gold]: gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward. [gold]Overload[/gold]: [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward. [gold]Warm[/gold]: no [gold]Heat[/gold] change.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROTOCOL_BREAKER.title: Protocol Breaker
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PROTOCOL_BREAKER.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then remove {ProtocolConsumed} [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] you applied to the target. If a stack was actually removed, gain {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYNCHRONIZE.title: Synchronize
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SYNCHRONIZE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Choose a [gold]Module[/gold] and trigger it twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TEMPERED_BY_HEAT.title: Tempered by Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GUARDED_FOCUS.title: Guarded Focus
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GUARDED_FOCUS.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have not played an Attack this turn, gain {MomentumGain:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. If you were in [gold]Warm[/gold] before playing this, gain {WarmMomentum:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold] instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FLUX_BLADE.title: Flux Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FLUX_BLADE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then move {HeatStep:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold] toward [gold]Warm[/gold]: gain [gold]Heat[/gold] in [gold]Cold[/gold], [gold]Vent[/gold] [gold]Heat[/gold] in [gold]Overload[/gold], no change in [gold]Warm[/gold]. If you were in [gold]Warm[/gold] before playing this, gain {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAINED_GUARD.title: Chained Guard
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAINED_GUARD.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you were already [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this, gain {ChainedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] instead, then [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_STRIKE.title: Sequence Strike
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_STRIKE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were already [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this, deal {ChainedDamage:diff()} damage {HitCount:diff()} times instead. If you were also in [gold]Cold[/gold], gain {HeatPower:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUNTERMEASURE.title: Countermeasure
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COUNTERMEASURE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target had [gold]Challenge Protocol[/gold] applied by you before playing this, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FINE_TUNING.title: Fine Tuning
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FINE_TUNING.description: Choose one: gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold] or vent 1 [gold]Heat[/gold]. Then [gold]Scan[/gold] {ScanCount}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GAIN_HEAT_TOKEN.title: Gain Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENT_HEAT_TOKEN.title: Vent Heat
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RED_ZONE_DIVE.title: Red-Zone Dive
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RED_ZONE_DIVE.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were not in [gold]Overload[/gold] before playing this, raise your [gold]Heat[/gold] to {TargetHeat} afterward. Otherwise, [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURNING_ADVANCE.title: Burning Advance
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURNING_ADVANCE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold]. The first time Burning Advance changes your [gold]Heat[/gold] zone each turn, return it to your [gold]hand[/gold] and set its cost to {ReturnCost} for the turn. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it after it is played again.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_PILEDRIVER.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. After you [gold]Overheat[/gold] this combat, this card costs no more than {DiscountCost}.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CORE_SPLITTER.title: Core Splitter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CORE_SPLITTER.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If your next [gold]Overheat[/gold] would deal at least {OverheatThreshold} damage, deal it {HitCount} times instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ABLATIVE_ARMOR.title: Ablative Armor
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.title: Residual Armor
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.descript: The first time you [gold]Overheat[/gold] each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] before taking [gold]Overheat[/gold] damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_RESIDUAL_ARMOR.smartDes: The first time you Overheat each turn, gain {Block} Block before taking Overheat damage.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_CUTTER.title: Phase Cutter
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_CUTTER.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Based on your zone before playing this: [gold]Cold[/gold] — apply {WeakPower} [gold]Weak[/gold]; [gold]Warm[/gold] — apply {LockStacks} [gold]Lock[/gold]; [gold]Overload[/gold] — [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold] afterward.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMODYNAMIC_CONVERSIO: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold]. For each [gold]Heat[/gold] actually [gold]Vented[/gold], gain {BlockPerHeat} more [gold]Block[/gold]. If you [gold]Vent[/gold] exactly {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold] this way, gain {EnergyGain} Energy.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ZONE_CALIBRATION.title: Zone Calibration
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ZONE_CALIBRATION.descri: Based on your zone before playing this: [gold]Cold[/gold] — gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold] and draw {DrawCount} card; [gold]Warm[/gold] — gain {WarmBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]; [gold]Overload[/gold] — [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold] and gain {OverloadBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRECISION_VENT.title: Precision Vent
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.title: Phase Shield
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.descriptio: The first time you change [gold]Heat[/gold] zones each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PHASE_SHIELD.smartDescr: The first time you change Heat zones each turn, gain {Block} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.title: Cooling Cycle
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.descripti: The first time you actually [gold]Vent[/gold] [gold]Heat[/gold] each turn, draw {DrawCount} card.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Gain {TriggerBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COOLING_CYCLE.smartDesc: The first time you actually Vent Heat each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards and gain {TriggerBlock} Block.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GATHER_EDGE.title: Gather Edge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_GATHER_EDGE.description: Gain {MomentumGain:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. If you are in the [gold]Warm[/gold] zone, gain {WarmBonus} additional [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHARGING_STANCE.title: Charging Stance
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHARGING_STANCE.descrip: At the end of your turn, if you played no Attacks this turn: gain {MomentumGain:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold] and add {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold]. If this leaves you in the [gold]Warm[/gold] zone, gain {WarmBonus} additional [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EDGEGUARD.title: Edgeguard
AURORAMOD-AURORA_EDGEGUARD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], then gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your [gold]Momentum[/gold], up to {MomentumBlockCap:diff()} extra [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DELAYED_SWEEP.title: Delayed Sweep
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DELAYED_SWEEP.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Deal 1 additional damage for every {MomentumPerDamage} [gold]Momentum[/gold], up to {MomentumDamageCap:diff()} additional damage. Does not clear [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_HEAT_FED_FOCUS.title: Heat-fed Focus
AURORAMOD-AURORA_HEAT_FED_FOCUS.descript: [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold]. Gain {MomentumPerHeat} [gold]Momentum[/gold] for each [gold]Heat[/gold] vented. If this drops you from the [gold]Overload[/gold] zone to the [gold]Warm[/gold] zone, gain {DropBonus:diff()} additional [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERLOAD_PROTOCOL.title: Overload Protocol
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERLOAD_PROTOCOL.descr: Draw {DrawCount} cards. If [gold]Chained[/gold], draw {ChainedDraw:diff()} additional card and add {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_STEP_SLASH.title: Step Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_STEP_SLASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have manually played exactly 3 cards this turn before playing this, apply {WeakStacks} [gold]Weak[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BROADCAST_SLASH.title: Broadcast Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BROADCAST_SLASH.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If [gold]Chained[/gold], deal it twice instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.title: Command Cache
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.descripti: The first time you become [gold]Chained[/gold] each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards.{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Also gain {BlockOnTrigger:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and add {HeatGain:diff()} [gold]Heat[/gold].}
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_CACHE.smartDesc: The first time you become Chained each turn, draw {DrawCount} cards, gain {BlockOnTrigger} Block and add {HeatGain} Heat.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAIN_DEFENSE.title: Chain Defense
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CHAIN_DEFENSE.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have manually played exactly 3 cards this turn before playing this, gain {ChainedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and draw {DrawCount} card instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY.title: Sentry Array
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SENTRY_ARRAY.descriptio: The first time you successfully [gold]Deploy[/gold] a [gold]Module[/gold] each turn, the new [gold]Module[/gold] gains {EnhancementAmount:diff()} [gold]Enhancement[/gold] and triggers once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASSAULT_REFIT.title: Assault Refit
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASSAULT_REFIT.descripti: [gold]Deploy[/gold] an [gold]Attack Module[/gold]. If successful, trigger all Attack [gold]Modules[/gold] {TriggerCount} times, then gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BULWARK_RECONFIGURATION: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Deploy[/gold] a [gold]Shield Module[/gold]. If successful, trigger the new [gold]Module[/gold] once. If you were in [gold]Cold[/gold] before playing this card, trigger it 1 additional time.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_ROTATION.title: Module Rotation
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MODULE_ROTATION.descrip: Choose a [gold]Module[/gold]. [gold]Rotate[/gold] it to the other type, retaining its [gold]Enhancement[/gold].{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| Then trigger it once.} Draw {DrawCount} card.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_INFUSION.title: Thermal Infusion
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_INFUSION.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you had at least 1 [gold]Module[/gold] before playing this card, all [gold]Modules[/gold] gain {EnhancementAmount} [gold]Enhancement[/gold], then gain {HeatGain} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FORMATION_ASSAULT.title: Formation Assault
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FORMATION_ASSAULT.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {DamagePerModule} for each deployed [gold]Module[/gold]. If you had both an [gold]Attack Module[/gold] and a [gold]Shield Module[/gold] before playing this card, [gold]Vent[/gold] {VentAmount} after the attack.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING.title: Thermal Routing
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_ROUTING.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain an effect based on your current [gold]Heat[/gold] zone: [gold]Cold[/gold]: Gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Warm[/gold]: Draw 1 card. [gold]Overload[/gold]: Gain 1 Energy, then gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK.title: Overclock
AURORAMOD-AURORA_OVERCLOCK.description: Gain 1 [gold]Overclock[/gold]. While you are in [gold]Overload[/gold] and have a pending [gold]Overheat[/gold], each stack gives your Attacks +75% final damage. When [gold]Overheat[/gold] resolves, take no [gold]Overheat[/gold] damage. Instead, lose 2 [gold]Max HP[/gold] per stack. [gold]Heat[/gold] is still cleared and [gold]System Crash[/gold] is still added. If you cannot pay in full, take the [gold]Overheat[/gold] damage instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURIAL_FURNACE.title: Burial Furnace
AURORAMOD-AURORA_BURIAL_FURNACE.descript: Whenever [gold]Overheat[/gold] finishes resolving and you are still alive, gain {StrengthPerOverheat:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LIMIT_FRACTURE.title: Limit Fracture
AURORAMOD-AURORA_LIMIT_FRACTURE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deals {HpScaling} additional damage for each HP you have actually lost this combat from your own cards or [gold]Overheat[/gold], up to {RiskBonusCap:diff()} additional damage. Then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASHEN_REKINDLING.title: Ashen Rekindling
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ASHEN_REKINDLING.descri: Gain 1 [gold]Ashen Rekindling[/gold]. When one of your cards or [gold]Overheat[/gold] would reduce your HP to 0, consume 1 stack to remain at 1 HP and gain 2 Energy. If this triggers outside your action phase, gain that Energy at the start of your next turn instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SCORCHED_EARTH_STORM.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If you were in [gold]Overload[/gold] before playing this card, deal it twice instead. Then gain {HeatPower} [gold]Heat[/gold]. If this newly locks in a pending [gold]Overheat[/gold], immediately [gold]Ignite[/gold] it; if you are still alive, deal it 1 additional time.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEVER_IN_ONE_STROKE.des: Clear all [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PerMomentum:diff()} damage for each [gold]Momentum[/gold] cleared.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOONLESS_BLADE.title: Moonless Blade
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOONLESS_BLADE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PerMomentum:diff()} damage for each [gold]Momentum[/gold] you have, counting up to {MomentumCap} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Do not clear [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_AMPLIFIER.desc: Gain {BaseGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Gain 1 additional [gold]Momentum[/gold] for each [gold]Momentum[/gold] you had before playing this card, up to {BonusCap} additional [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_AUTONOMOUS_ARSENAL.desc: At the end of your turn, if your [gold]Module slots[/gold] are full, trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] 1 additional time, then gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_CHASSIS.title: Adaptive Chassis
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ADAPTIVE_CHASSIS.descri: The first {MaxUses} time(s) each turn you [gold]Rotate[/gold] a [gold]Module[/gold] or successfully replace one at full slots, give the resulting [gold]Module[/gold] 3 [gold]Enhancement[/gold] and trigger it once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_UNIFICATION.title: Array Unification
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_UNIFICATION.descr: Choose Attack or Shield. [gold]Rotate[/gold] all [gold]Modules[/gold] into the chosen type, preserving their [gold]Enhancement[/gold]. Then trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] twice.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ANNIHILATION_COMMAND.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you had manually played at least 6 cards this turn before playing this card, deal it {HitCount} times instead.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_CLOSED_LOOP_DEFENSE.des: Gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {PerCard:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card you manually played earlier this turn, counting up to 6 cards. If you had played at least 6, then [gold]Vent[/gold] up to {VentMax} [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_RECHARGE.title: Command Recharge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_COMMAND_RECHARGE.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you had manually played at least 3 cards this turn before playing this card, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy. If at least 6, draw 2 cards and gain 2 Energy instead.
Whenever [gold]Chain[/gold] activates, trigger an effect based on your current [gold]Heat[/gold] Zone: [gold]Cold[/gold]: Gain 4 [gold]Momentum[/gold]. [gold]Warm[/gold]: Give 2 [gold]Enhancement[/gold] to your least-enhanced [gold]Module[/gold]. [gold]Overload[/gold]: Trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_RESONANCE.desc: At the start of your turn, if you have less than {Threshold} [gold]Momentum[/gold], gain {MomentumGain} [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Otherwise, draw {DrawCount} cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_BULWARK.title: Momentum Bulwark
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_BULWARK.descri: Clear all [gold]Momentum[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus 2 [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Momentum[/gold] cleared. If you cleared at least 8 [gold]Momentum[/gold], draw 2 cards.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DISMANTLING_SLASH.title: Dismantling Slash
AURORAMOD-AURORA_DISMANTLING_SLASH.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. You may choose and remove a [gold]Module[/gold]. If you do, deal {RemoveDamage:diff()} damage instead, plus 5 damage for each [gold]Enhancement[/gold] it had.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FOCUSED_MATRIX.title: Focused Matrix
AURORAMOD-AURORA_FOCUSED_MATRIX.descript: Choose a [gold]Module[/gold]. Give it [gold]Enhancement[/gold] equal to the number of [gold]Modules[/gold] you have{IfUpgraded:choose(0):| plus 1}, then trigger it that many times plus 1.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_CUTOFF.title: Sequence Cutoff
AURORAMOD-AURORA_SEQUENCE_CUTOFF.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this card, deal {Damage:diff()} damage again. Then [gold]Vent[/gold] all [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_INFINITE_CALCULATION.de: Draw until you have {Target} cards in [gold]hand[/gold]. If you were [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this card, draw until you have {ChainedTarget} instead. Gain 1 [gold]Heat[/gold] for each card actually drawn this way.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_TEMPERING.title: Reactor Tempering
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REACTOR_TEMPERING.descr: Whenever an [gold]Overheat[/gold] finishes resolving and you are still alive, gain {MomentumGain:diff()} [gold]Momentum[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_EXECUTION.title: Array Execution
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARRAY_EXECUTION.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you were [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this card and your [gold]Module slots[/gold] were full, deal {EmpoweredDamage:diff()} damage instead, trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once, then gain 2 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_INFUSION.title: Momentum Infusion
AURORAMOD-AURORA_MOMENTUM_INFUSION.descr: Clear all [gold]Momentum[/gold]. For every 3 [gold]Momentum[/gold] cleared, give all [gold]Modules[/gold] 1 [gold]Enhancement[/gold], up to 4 [gold]Enhancement[/gold]. Then trigger all [gold]Modules[/gold] once.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_THERMAL_BULWARK_RELAY.d: Target ally gains {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Vent[/gold] up to 4 [gold]Heat[/gold]. For each [gold]Heat[/gold] actually [gold]Vented[/gold], that ally gains 2 additional [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TACTICAL_RELAY.title: Tactical Relay
AURORAMOD-AURORA_TACTICAL_RELAY.descript: Target ally draws 1 card and gains 1 Energy. If you were [gold]Chained[/gold] before playing this, that ally draws 2 and gains 1 Energy instead; if so, gain 2 [gold]Heat[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARMOR_SLAM.title: Armor Slam
AURORAMOD-AURORA_ARMOR_SLAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Damage is equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REDUNDANT_PLATING.title: Redundant Plating
AURORAMOD-AURORA_REDUNDANT_PLATING.descr: At the start of your turn, retain half of your [gold]Block[/gold].
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENTED_EDGE.title: Vented Edge
AURORAMOD-AURORA_VENTED_EDGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Every {PerStacks} [gold]Momentum[/gold] increases the damage by {PerBonus}, up to {MaxBonus}. Does not clear [gold]Momentum[/gold].
